{
  "slides": [
    {
      "n": 1,
      "title": "BeanBox: Kyiv’s Data-Driven Specialty Coffee Subscription",
      "key_message": "BeanBox combines artisanal roasting with growth marketing to capture the premium home-brewing trend in Kyiv.",
      "bullets": [
        "Specialty coffee subscription service based in Kyiv.",
        "Founded by a roaster and a growth marketer.",
        "Rapid traction: 400 paying subscribers in 6 months."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f1",
        "f2",
        "f5",
        "f8"
      ],
      "visual": "Split image: high-quality coffee bean texture on one side, a clean dashboard graphic showing subscriber growth on the other."
    },
    {
      "n": 2,
      "title": "Traction & Unit Economics",
      "key_message": "Proven product-market fit with predictable recurring revenue, though key efficiency metrics are currently being refined.",
      "bullets": [
        "400 paying subscribers acquired in 6 months.",
        "Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) ≈ 7,200 EUR (400 × 18 EUR).",
        "Subscription price: 18 EUR/month.",
        "Note: Churn rate and CAC are currently being optimized; data available in diligence."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f2",
        "f3",
        "f4",
        "f5"
      ],
      "visual": "Simple bar chart showing MRR growth over the last 6 months, with a footnote indicating 'Churn & CAC: Under Review'."
    },
    {
      "n": 3,
      "title": "The Team: Complementary Expertise",
      "key_message": "The founding duo covers the two critical pillars of DTC success: product excellence and customer acquisition.",
      "bullets": [
        "Co-founder 1: Master Roaster (Technical/Product Quality).",
        "Co-founder 2: Growth Marketer (Acquisition/Retention).",
        "Structure designed to balance artisanal quality with scalable growth."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f8",
        "f23"
      ],
      "visual": "Photos of the two founders with their titles and a brief 1-line credential for each (e.g., '10 years roasting', 'Scaled DTC brand to X')."
    },
    {
      "n": 4,
      "title": "Market Opportunity: Kyiv’s Specialty Shift",
      "key_message": "Kyiv’s coffee culture has shifted towards premium home brewing, creating a dense competitive landscape that validates demand.",
      "bullets": [
        "Ukraine's coffee market estimated at USD 300–400 million annually (medium confidence).",
        "Strong post-2022 shift towards home brewing and specialty roasters.",
        "Kyiv hosts a dense landscape of specialty roasters (Kyiv City Roastery, Kolo Coffee, Idealist), proving consumer demand for premium local coffee."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f10",
        "f11",
        "f13",
        "f19"
      ],
      "visual": "Map of Kyiv highlighting competitor locations to show market density, or a graphic showing the 'Home Brewing' trend arrow."
    },
    {
      "n": 5,
      "title": "The Bottleneck: Capacity Constraint",
      "key_message": "Current production capacity is the primary limit to growth; we cannot scale beyond current subscriber levels without infrastructure investment.",
      "bullets": [
        "Current roastery is operating at/near full capacity.",
        "Inability to fulfill increased demand or scale efficiently.",
        "Hypothesis: A second roastery is required to unlock scale (to be validated by utilization data)."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f22"
      ],
      "visual": "A simple 'Capacity vs. Demand' line graph where the demand line crosses the flat capacity line, highlighting the gap."
    },
    {
      "n": 6,
      "title": "The Solution: Second Roastery",
      "key_message": "Opening a second roastery is the specific, necessary step to remove production bottlenecks and support a larger subscriber base.",
      "bullets": [
        "Direct investment in production infrastructure.",
        "Enables scaling beyond the current 400-subscriber limit.",
        "Mitigates risk of contract roasting (quality control, margin retention)."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f7",
        "f22"
      ],
      "visual": "Render or photo of the proposed second roastery space or equipment list."
    },
    {
      "n": 7,
      "title": "Competitive Landscape & Differentiation",
      "key_message": "We operate in a mature market with established players, but our subscription model offers superior convenience and curation.",
      "bullets": [
        "Competitors: Kyiv City Roastery, Kolo Coffee, Idealist Coffee.",
        "Differentiation: Curated subscription experience vs. retail-only.",
        "Value prop: 18 EUR/month offers significant volume discount vs. single-cup cafe pricing (80–200 UAH)."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f11",
        "f15",
        "f16",
        "f20"
      ],
      "visual": "Comparison table: BeanBox Subscription vs. Single Cup Cafe Price vs. Competitor Subscription."
    },
    {
      "n": 8,
      "title": "Business Model: Recurring Revenue",
      "key_message": "Simple, predictable unit economics built on a recurring subscription model.",
      "bullets": [
        "Price: 18 EUR/month.",
        "Recurring revenue stream from day one.",
        "Gross margin per subscription: To be disclosed in diligence (currently estimating based on COGS)."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f3",
        "f4"
      ],
      "visual": "Icon of a coffee box with '18 EUR' and a recurring arrow symbol."
    },
    {
      "n": 9,
      "title": "The Ask: 300k EUR",
      "key_message": "Raising 300,000 EUR to fund the construction and equipment of our second roastery.",
      "bullets": [
        "Use of Funds: Second roastery construction & equipment.",
        "Goal: Unlock capacity to scale subscriber base.",
        "Runway: Projected [X] months post-investment (to be detailed in diligence)."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f6",
        "f7"
      ],
      "visual": "Pie chart of the 300k EUR allocation (e.g., 60% Equipment, 30% Build-out, 10% Working Capital)."
    },
    {
      "n": 10,
      "title": "Why Now?",
      "key_message": "With proven traction, a strong team, and a clear capacity bottleneck, this is the optimal moment to invest in infrastructure.",
      "bullets": [
        "Validated demand (400 subs in 6 months).",
        "Team ready to scale (Roaster + Marketer).",
        "Infrastructure is the only remaining barrier to growth."
      ],
      "evidence": [
        "f5",
        "f22",
        "f23"
      ],
      "visual": "Timeline graphic showing 'Traction' -> 'Bottleneck' -> 'Investment' -> 'Scale'."
    }
  ],
  "tone": "confident",
  "minority_report": "The capacity constraint claim is presented as a hypothesis because the brief lacks utilization data or waitlist numbers; investors may view the need for a second roastery at only 400 subscribers as premature without proof of current operational limits. Additionally, the lack of churn, CAC, and gross margin data makes it impossible to validate the sustainability of the business model or the efficiency of the growth strategy."
}
